statement: The independently approved 32-path MovieLens paired-runtime adapter replacement is projected without byte changes onto the parent Quest's reachable M1 base, receives exact candidate approval at that base, and contributes complete same-base coverage for decomposition of the standing parent rejection.

constraints.statement: The candidate base must be exactly 6d284fbc3fc03cdc9b997fd6a74428ebc7def92c, the reachable M1 commit named by the standing parent rejection.

The source delta must be the exact 32-path, 411992-byte canonical delta sha256:28dbdcf505912296f2bed9c9ed8ab869d0c6fb227a2bd6eb442719e3f9ccfc7b already approved in comparative-efficiency-movielens-paired-runtime-adapters-verifier-closure; no source byte or rejected path may change.

This Quest only reconciles the exact approved candidate receipt to the parent base. It must reuse the source-bound root sha256:609af80f5aad5ebdd84918802fe79bbe41b9b7fcada797b510c8ec925a66d5b7 and must not publish a matrix-wide claim or describe the representative adapter proof as the measured campaign.

An independent verifier must confirm the M1-base canonical delta is byte-identical to the approved successor delta, the current source bytes reproduce it, and the exact candidate receipt is eligible to discharge all remaining parent rejection paths.
